testDesignNotes: Attack and physical-attack declarations are real payload shapes sent through the host broadcastEvent seam and appended to the store for the real replay call (ruling S-PREP-P2, admission receipt); movement is additionally driven by real intents in sealedChoiceDelivery.

Delivery numbers are per player, not per socket: a replay sent to a second socket of the same player stamps numbers from the same cursor, so the pre-reveal replay row is a separate test from the live gapless-number row.
Each withheld row also asserts that a public control event reached the same live socket and that replay was non-empty, so a dead or silent socket cannot pass.
